patch_list: Auto-skip intro and recap

Automatically skips the intro and recap of a show instead of waiting for you to press the Skip button. When the player reaches an intro (SKIP_INTRO_MARKER=1) or recap (SKIP_RECAP_MARKER=2) marker, it does exactly what tapping the Skip butt…
Change app name
Changes the app name shown under the launcher icon. Set the desired name in the patch options.
Disable forced upgrade

Disable nuisance popups

Faster video start

Make installable on TV

Remove display ads

Removes ZEE5 non-video display ads: the home-screen native masthead banner (HomeActivityViewModel.getNeedToShowNativeMastheadAd() forced false, so it never loads) and the on-pause display overlay (FetchPlaybackUrlUseCase.toPauseAds() force…

sources.label: aapam
sources.author: aapam
patch_list: Disable ads

Removes Google IMA ad insertion (client-side and server-side DAI) from the ZEE5 player. The media source factory is returned DRM-configured but with ad-insertion components never attached, so content and DRM playback are unaffected.
Disable analytics
Disables all third-party analytics (CleverTap, Firebase, Mixpanel, videoanalytics) by short-circuiting the central analytics dispatch method. No tracking data is sent.
Disable CleverTap
Prevents the CleverTap analytics SDK from initializing, stopping behavioral tracking and advertising-id (GAID) collection.
Disable Firebase analytics
Prevents Firebase Analytics from initializing, stopping event and user-property reporting to Google.
